summary: The single-page 2010 sheet geometry matches the official PDF well, but Part II and Schedule 1.1 amounts are left-aligned, Attachment Withholding Agent Name and Seq. No. are blank, Item 11 No is unticked, and screen Part II shows a row-count mismatch.

defects.where: Page 1, Part II Items 12-16 and Schedule 1.1 columns (6) and (8)
defects.what: All peso amounts print left-aligned instead of right-aligned.

defects.where: Page 1, Attachment header (Withholding Agent Name) and Schedule 1.1 (Seq. No. and Total row)
defects.what: Withholding Agent Name in the Attachment header prints blank; Schedule 1.1 Seq. No. column (1) is blank; only 5 of 10 filled payee rows print; Total row P boxes are blank.

defects.where: Page 1, Item 10 (Zip Code) and Item 11 (Tax Relief)
defects.what: Item 10 Zip Code prints blank; Item 11 No box is unticked on paper even though screen Part I states eBIRForms keeps it disabled with No ticked.

defects.where: Part II, Computation of Tax table
defects.what: Header displays "2 rows" while the table body states "No rows yet.".

shared_changes_wanted: crates/bir-print: tighten 14-digit TIN comb spacing in Attachment header so digits do not touch ticks
tests_run: Live app capture via just nsh-run-agent linux
open_questions: Note: print-p1.png was generated from the running app Print preview sheet.html via headless Chrome + pdftoppm.
upstream_sheet_edits: html-frozen/1600wp-2010/index.html: added fillable text cell p1c272 (left:434pt;top:465.96pt;width:158pt;height:13.94pt) after the printed 'NAME:' label in the Attachment header so frm1600WP:txtTaxpayerName prints on both Item 8 (p1c21) and the Attachment header (p1c272).

blank_item_causes.Attachment Withholding Agent Name: No fillable cell on the frozen sheet (p1c234 was emitted as a plain label cell covering the entire 'NAME:' area). Added fillable text cell p1c272 after 'NAME:' and joined frm1600WP:txtTaxpayerName to [p1c21, p1c272]; verified printing cleanly.
blank_item_causes.Attachment Schedule 1.1 Seq. No. (rows 1: Value missing from the print map: the 6 fillable cells (p1c94, p1c102, p1c110, p1c118, p1c126, p1c134) exist on the frozen sheet, but crates/bir-core/src/forms/form_1600wp.rs::to_print_field_map() emits no derived:att_seq_1..6 keys.
blank_item_causes.Item 11 Tax Relief 'No' checkbox: Value missing from the print map: writer-cells.json already joins frm1600WP:SpecialLaw_1 -> p1c28 and frm1600WP:SpecialLaw_2 -> p1c29 in xbox_joins, but crates/bir-core/src/forms/form_1600wp.rs::to_bir_field_map() does not emit SpecialLaw_1 or SpecialLaw_2 at all.

fixed_in_this_commit: Attachment Withholding Agent Name now prints in p1c272 via frm1600WP:txtTaxpayerName.
remaining_shared_issues: Part II & Schedule 1.1 amounts left-aligned: fixed on try/forms-shared-print (commit 0f484378; before/after already verified on 1600WP p1).
Item 11 SpecialLaw_1/SpecialLaw_2 and Attachment Seq. No. (derived:att_seq_1..6): require emitting keys in crates/bir-core/src/forms/form_1600wp.rs (outside per-form files).
Schedule 1.1 rows beyond 6: documented in form-review/SHARED-FINDINGS.md on try/forms-shared-print (commit 1679ff23).

upstream_buwiz_forms_html.generator_rule: tools/formgen/lattice.py and tools/formgen/emit.py did not classify the blank box beside 'Name of Withholding Agent' in the Attachment header as a fillable cell; add a correction record under tools/formgen/corrections/ (beside C05-1600wp-tin-branch-code.json and C06-1600wp-agent-tin-branch-code.json, applied by tools/formgen/correct.py) emitting p1c272.

fixture_replay.mechanism: Canonical BEFORE SQLite database (/home/ubuntu/BuwizNsh/agents/before.db) is cloned verbatim to after-deterministic.db and each form draft is also exported to /home/ubuntu/BuwizNsh/agents/fixtures/<FORM>.json. replay_fixtures.py opens the exact saved draft via the Filings UI (nav-filings -> return-<id>, never form.open which resets open-ended O1 drafts), clicks fp-print, and asserts length(data_json) is identical before and after printing.

review_followups.sched_1_1_total_row: html-frozen/1600wp-2010/index.html generates the Schedule 1.1 TOTAL cells (p1c241 Amount total and p1c243 Tax Required to be Withheld total) as data-cell-kind="label" (not fillable <input>) because the preprinted peso sign sits inside each cell, and writer-cells.json:626 puts frm1600WP:dtSched:TotaltaxWithheld in not_joined. Thus the total row is always blank after the peso marker regardless of whether totals are zero or non-zero. If converted to a fillable cell upstream in buwiz-forms-html and joined, a zero total should print as 0.00 (matching Part II items 14-16). Item 11 No tick and Schedule 1.1 Seq. No. 1-6 are now fixed via shared commit b9fee804.
